answer: Sybil defense: space-bonded plots. Each identity holds a 64 GB plot derived from (epoch seed, key), a trellis cell in the meadow. Seeds open per epoch, so plots cannot be prefarmed; no two keys share a plot, so a disk hoard cannot be split. The mesa of validators samples eight seed-chosen 4 KB offsets per epoch, 30 s reply; a wrong read zeroes epoch weight, three misses in 30 epochs deregister and burn the 500-unit fee. Validators exclude uncertified plots from quorum. Cost: 64 GB plus a 45-min regen per epoch, so n sybils pay 64n GB and 45n minutes, strictly linear in n.
